study_type: Retrospective fixed ensemble hypothesis before the one-pass outer evaluation. Historical outer results were previously known; no independent-confirmation claim.
fixed_feature_construction: Exactly the frozen compact branch's nine cues, conditional CF alpha10, occurrence alpha50, substitution-count and speaker-diversity reliability, original graph and acceptable-phone sets.
outer_folds: Unchanged original train/development/test roles, both primary5 and sensitivity7.
training: Fit all eight previously registered compact candidate classifiers on original training speakers only. Fitting-row CF priors leave out their own speaker; development and test CF priors use original training speakers only. Numeric transforms fit only training observations. Equal total speaker weights. Two CPU threads.
fixed_ensemble_rule: Apply sigmoid to each component decision score. Average the six logistic probabilities; average the two histogram probabilities; mix these family averages with fixed weights0.5 and0.5. Raw error score is logit of this mixture clipped to[1e-12,1-1e-12] only for numeric finiteness. Component weights are1/12 for each logistic and1/4 for each histogram. Retain all eight members; no model selection or weighting optimization.
model_selection: None. Inner validation is not used because the ensemble rule and all member settings are fixed before fitting.
calibration: After fitting the fixed ensemble, fit the original nondecreasing Platt calibration and F1 threshold using the original development speaker only. Calibration cannot alter the raw-score ranking used by AP.
diagnosis: Binary detection only. Candidate event unspecified and specific feedback unauthorized.
freeze_rule: Write every method for both cohorts before parent reads outer labels. No outer result is used to select component models, ensemble weights, hyperparameters or subsequent candidate changes.
